paragraphs.en: PHP is a popular general-purpose scripting language that is especially suited to web development. Fast, flexible and pragmatic, PHP powers everything from your blog to the most popular websites in the world.
paragraphs.zh: PHP 是一种流行的通用脚本语言，特别适合 Web 开发。 PHP 快速、灵活且务实，支撑着从你的博客到世界上最受欢迎的网站的一切。

sents.en: PHP is a popular general-purpose scripting language that is especially suited to web development.
sents.zh: PHP 是一种流行的通用脚本语言，特别适合 Web 开发。

sents.en: Fast, flexible and pragmatic, PHP powers everything from your blog to the most popular websites in the world.
sents.zh: PHP 快速、灵活且务实，支撑着从你的博客到世界上最受欢迎的网站的一切。

paragraphs.en: PHP is distributed under the Modified BSD License (SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause ).
paragraphs.zh: PHP 依据修改版 BSD 许可证（Modified BSD License，SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause）分发。

paragraphs.en: The PHP manual is available at php.net/docs .
paragraphs.zh: PHP 手册可在 php.net/docs 获取。

paragraphs.en: Prebuilt packages and binaries can be used to get up and running fast with PHP.
paragraphs.zh: 预构建的软件包和二进制文件可用于帮助你快速上手 PHP。

paragraphs.en: For Windows, the PHP binaries can be obtained from windows.php.net . After extracting the archive the *.exe files are ready to use.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Windows 上，PHP 二进制文件可以从 windows.php.net 获取。 解压缩压缩包后，*.exe 文件即可直接使用。

sents.en: For Windows, the PHP binaries can be obtained from windows.php.net .
sents.zh: 在 Windows 上，PHP 二进制文件可以从 windows.php.net 获取。

sents.en: After extracting the archive the *.exe files are ready to use.
sents.zh: 解压缩压缩包后，*.exe 文件即可直接使用。

paragraphs.en: For other systems, see the installation chapter .
paragraphs.zh: 对于其他系统，请参阅安装章节。

paragraphs.en: For Windows, see Build your own PHP on Windows .
paragraphs.zh: Windows 用户请参阅 Build your own PHP on Windows 。

paragraphs.en: For a minimal PHP build from Git, you will need autoconf, bison, and re2c. For a default build, you will additionally need libxml2 and libsqlite3.
paragraphs.zh: 若要从 Git 进行最小化的 PHP 构建，你需要 autoconf、bison 和 re2c。 若要进行默认构建，你还需要 libxml2 和 libsqlite3。

sents.en: For a minimal PHP build from Git, you will need autoconf, bison, and re2c.
sents.zh: 若要从 Git 进行最小化的 PHP 构建，你需要 autoconf、bison 和 re2c。

sents.en: For a default build, you will additionally need libxml2 and libsqlite3.
sents.zh: 若要进行默认构建，你还需要 libxml2 和 libsqlite3。

paragraphs.en: sudo apt install -y pkg-config build-essential autoconf bison re2c libxml2-dev libsqlite3-dev On Fedora, you can install these using:
paragraphs.zh: sudo apt install -y pkg-config build-essential autoconf bison re2c libxml2-dev libsqlite3-dev 在 Fedora 上，你可以使用以下命令安装这些依赖：

paragraphs.en: sudo dnf install re2c bison autoconf make ccache libxml2-devel sqlite-devel On MacOS, you can install these using brew :
paragraphs.zh: sudo dnf install re2c bison autoconf make ccache libxml2-devel sqlite-devel 在 MacOS 上，你可以使用 brew 来安装这些依赖：

paragraphs.en: brew install autoconf bison re2c libiconv libxml2 sqlite or with MacPorts :
paragraphs.zh: 使用 brew 安装 autoconf bison re2c libiconv libxml2 sqlite，或者使用 MacPorts：

paragraphs.en: sudo port install autoconf bison re2c libiconv libxml2 sqlite3 Generate configure:
paragraphs.zh: sudo port install autoconf bison re2c libiconv libxml2 sqlite3 生成 configure：

paragraphs.en: ./buildconf Configure your build. --enable-debug is recommended for development, see ./configure --help for a full list of options.
paragraphs.zh: ./buildconf 配置你的构建。开发时建议使用 --enable-debug，完整选项列表请参见 ./configure --help。

paragraphs.en: # For development ./configure --enable-debug # For production ./configure Build PHP. To speed up the build, specify the maximum number of jobs using the -j argument:
paragraphs.zh: # 开发环境 ./configure --enable-debug # 生产环境 ./configure 编译 PHP。 若要加快编译速度，可使用 -j 参数指定最大并行任务数：

sents.en: # For development ./configure --enable-debug # For production ./configure Build PHP.
sents.zh: # 开发环境 ./configure --enable-debug # 生产环境 ./configure 编译 PHP。

sents.en: To speed up the build, specify the maximum number of jobs using the -j argument:
sents.zh: 若要加快编译速度，可使用 -j 参数指定最大并行任务数：

paragraphs.en: make -j4 The number of jobs should usually match the number of available cores, which can be determined using nproc .
paragraphs.zh: make -j4 并行任务数通常应与可用核心数一致，可通过 nproc 查询。

paragraphs.en: PHP ships with an extensive test suite, the command make test is used after successful compilation of the sources to run this test suite.
paragraphs.zh: PHP 自带了一套庞大的测试套件，在成功编译源代码后，可以使用 make test 命令来运行这个测试套件。

paragraphs.en: Tests run in parallel by default, using up to 10 detected logical processors. Set -jN in TEST_PHP_ARGS or TESTS to override the worker count:
paragraphs.zh: 测试默认并行运行，最多使用检测到的 10 个逻辑处理器。 在 TEST_PHP_ARGS 或 TESTS 中设置 -jN 来覆盖工作进程数量：

sents.en: Tests run in parallel by default, using up to 10 detected logical processors.
sents.zh: 测试默认并行运行，最多使用检测到的 10 个逻辑处理器。

sents.en: Set -jN in TEST_PHP_ARGS or TESTS to override the worker count:
sents.zh: 在 TEST_PHP_ARGS 或 TESTS 中设置 -jN 来覆盖工作进程数量：

paragraphs.en: make TEST_PHP_ARGS=-j4 test This runs make test with a maximum of 4 concurrent jobs. Alternatively, use -j1 to run tests sequentially.
paragraphs.zh: make TEST_PHP_ARGS=-j4 test 这会以最多 4 个并发任务运行 make test。 或者，使用 -j1 顺序运行测试。

sents.en: make TEST_PHP_ARGS=-j4 test This runs make test with a maximum of 4 concurrent jobs.
sents.zh: make TEST_PHP_ARGS=-j4 test 这会以最多 4 个并发任务运行 make test。

sents.en: Alternatively, use -j1 to run tests sequentially.
sents.zh: 或者，使用 -j1 顺序运行测试。

paragraphs.en: Use the TEST_PHP_ARGS or TESTS variable to test only specific directories:
paragraphs.zh: 使用 TEST_PHP_ARGS 或 TESTS 变量来仅测试特定目录：

paragraphs.en: make TESTS=tests/lang/ test The qa.php.net site provides more detailed info about testing and quality assurance.
paragraphs.zh: make TESTS=tests/lang/ test qa.php.net 网站提供了关于测试和质量保证的更详细信息。

paragraphs.en: After a successful build (and test), PHP may be installed with:
paragraphs.zh: 构建成功（并通过测试）后，可以使用以下命令安装 PHP：

paragraphs.en: make install Depending on your permissions and prefix, make install may need superuser permissions.
paragraphs.zh: make install 根据你的权限和前缀设置，make install 可能需要超级用户权限。

paragraphs.en: Extensions provide additional functionality on top of PHP. PHP consists of many essential bundled extensions. Additional extensions can be found on the PIE Extensions list, and installed with 🥧 PIE, the PHP Installer for Extensions or the deprecated PHP Extension Community Library - PECL .
paragraphs.zh: 扩展在 PHP 之上提供了额外的功能。 PHP 包含许多重要的内置扩展。 更多扩展可以在 PIE 扩展列表中找到，并可使用 🥧 PIE（PHP 扩展安装器）或已弃用的 PHP 扩展社区库 - PECL 进行安装。

sents.en: Extensions provide additional functionality on top of PHP.
sents.zh: 扩展在 PHP 之上提供了额外的功能。

sents.en: PHP consists of many essential bundled extensions.
sents.zh: PHP 包含许多重要的内置扩展。

sents.en: Additional extensions can be found on the PIE Extensions list, and installed with 🥧 PIE, the PHP Installer for Extensions or the deprecated PHP Extension Community Library - PECL .
sents.zh: 更多扩展可以在 PIE 扩展列表中找到，并可使用 🥧 PIE（PHP 扩展安装器）或已弃用的 PHP 扩展社区库 - PECL 进行安装。

paragraphs.en: The PHP source code is located in the Git repository at github.com/php/php-src . Contributions are most welcome by forking the repository and sending a pull request.
paragraphs.zh: PHP 源代码位于 GitHub 仓库 github.com/php/php-src 中。 欢迎通过 fork 该仓库并发送拉取请求（pull request）来贡献代码。

sents.en: The PHP source code is located in the Git repository at github.com/php/php-src .
sents.zh: PHP 源代码位于 GitHub 仓库 github.com/php/php-src 中。

sents.en: Contributions are most welcome by forking the repository and sending a pull request.
sents.zh: 欢迎通过 fork 该仓库并发送拉取请求（pull request）来贡献代码。

paragraphs.en: Discussions are done on GitHub, but depending on the topic can also be relayed to the official PHP developer mailing list internals@lists.php.net .
paragraphs.zh: 讨论在 GitHub 上进行，但根据话题的不同，也可能转达至 PHP 官方开发者邮件列表 internals@lists.php.net。

paragraphs.en: New features require an RFC and must be accepted by the developers. See Request for comments - RFC and Voting on PHP features for more information on the process.
paragraphs.zh: 新功能需要一份 RFC，并且必须被开发者接受。 有关该流程的更多信息，请参阅「征求意见稿 - RFC」和「对 PHP 特性进行投票」。

sents.en: New features require an RFC and must be accepted by the developers.
sents.zh: 新功能需要一份 RFC，并且必须被开发者接受。

sents.en: See Request for comments - RFC and Voting on PHP features for more information on the process.
sents.zh: 有关该流程的更多信息，请参阅「征求意见稿 - RFC」和「对 PHP 特性进行投票」。

paragraphs.en: Bug fixes don't require an RFC. If the bug has a GitHub issue, reference it in the commit message using GH-NNNNNN . Use #NNNNNN for tickets in the old bugs.php.net bug tracker.
paragraphs.zh: 修复错误（Bug）不需要 RFC。 如果该错误已有 GitHub issue，请在提交信息中使用 GH-NNNNNN 引用它。 对于旧版 bugs.php.net 错误跟踪系统中的工单，请使用 #NNNNNN。

paragraphs.en: Fix GH-7815: php_uname doesn't recognise latest Windows versions Fix #55371: get_magic_quotes_gpc() throws deprecation warning See Git workflow for details on how pull requests are merged.
paragraphs.zh: 修复 GH-7815：php_uname 无法识别最新的 Windows 版本 修复 #55371：get_magic_quotes_gpc() 抛出弃用警告 有关拉取请求如何被合并的详细信息，请参阅 Git 工作流。

paragraphs.zh: 有关如何参与贡献的更多信息，请参阅代码库中的更多文档：

paragraphs.zh: 有关为 PHP 做出贡献的人员列表，请参阅 PHP 致谢页面。
